rationale: I read the full held EO 13137 (64 FR 50733) and the full held EO 13316 (68 FR 55255) myself before reading the producer rationale. EO 13137 is a pure amending order: it rewrites sec. 3 of EO 12975, adds a new sec. 4, renumbers and moves the NBAC termination to Oct. 3, 2001; it has no independent command outside EO 12975. EO 13316 sec. 3(b) revokes 'Executive Order 12975, as amended by Executive Orders 13018, 13046, and 13137', naming EO 13137 expressly, with no carve-out or savings language; sec. 6 makes it effective Sept. 30, 2003. I tried to refute the NO: nothing in EO 13316 continues the NBAC (sec. 1 continues the separate President's Council on Bioethics under EO 13237), and no later held order revives EO 12975. My independent view is NO; I agree. First end (own-term lapse Oct. 3, 2001 vs. Sept. 30, 2003 revocation) stays a lifecycle gap.
